topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I appreciate you reaching out to me about the fence. It's a big step, and I want to make sure we're both on the same page about how it will look and where it will go. I've been reading up on local ordinances just to make sure we stay within the guidelines. Also, I've noted down a few questions about the materials and the process. When you have a moment, maybe we could go over these together? I think it’s important that we both feel good about the decision, and I really value your input. Let me know a convenient time for you.
